description: Find nurseries, pre-schools and out-of-school clubs registered with Ofsted near a postcode or place in England, with places and the latest Ofsted grade. Childminders are not included.

limit.description: Most providers to return, nearest first, 1 to 100 (default 25)

location.description: A UK postcode or a town, city or district in England

type.description: all, full_day (nurseries open all day), sessional (pre-schools) or out_of_school (default all)

name: find_nurseries
